messages.subject: extract summary values ​​generated by SAVEDATA
parts:
Dear, I am grateful to received a lot of help from Michael and other colleagues on this site. I have one more question and I would like to ask for help. Is it possible to extract summary values ​​(H0, AIC, BIC, etc.) for each replication generated by savedata in the simulation study using mplusautomation ? Manual say that "getSavedata_Data" refers to an output file, not actual dataset generated by savedata.


Best Regards,
Sookyoung Son.

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: extract summary values ​​generated by SAVEDATA
parts:
Hi Sookyoung,

I'm not sure if I completely follow your question, but my understanding is that if Mplus is used to run a Monte Carlo study, it keeps only the summary statistics for each global index (e.g., mean AIC), but does not have the replication-level statistics. If you want the statistics for every replication, you'd need to run them individually (e.g., using runModels), then extract the results with readModels, and compile the desired statistics from the individual outputs.

This is essentially what is done in the Monte Carlo example from the Structural Equation Modeling paper. Code for this is here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/tree/master/examples/monte_carlo. The example of compiling statistics is https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/blob/master/examples/monte_carlo/PlotFMMResults.R. That script wasn't really polished for general use, but gives the idea of compiling AIC across thousands of outputs.

Best,
Michael
